verdict.rationale: Yapily documents an official MCP endpoint that Claude, Cursor, or other agents can connect to, and a probe confirms the AI-agents page. However, that MCP connection only gives the agent a live, searchable view of the documentation. Nothing shows the MCP server exposing the actual Data or Payments API (accounts, transactions, payments) as agent tools. Missing for 10: MCP tools for Yapily's banking/payment APIs, setup and auth details for the MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration.
